statement.zh: **算法**：FEAL 分组密码（Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm）。HAC 第 7.5 节一开头就点出对象并说明它出名在什么地方：「The Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL) is a family of algorithms which has played a critical role in the development and refinement of various advanced cryptanalytic techniques, including linear and differential cryptanalysis.」（快速数据加密算法 FEAL 是一族算法，在各种高级密码分析技术的发展与打磨中起过关键作用，其中包括线性分析与差分分析）。参数就在同一行给出：「FEAL-N maps 64-bit plaintext to 64-bit ciphertext blocks under a 64-bit secret key.」（FEAL-N 在 64 位保密密钥下把 64 位明文映射为 64 位密文块）；结构表述为 「It is an N -round Feistel cipher similar to DES (cf.Equations (7.4), (7.
statement.en: **Algorithm**: Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL 分组密码).HAC 7.5 opens by naming the object and saying what it is known for: "The Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL) is a family of algorithms which has played a critical role in the development and refinement of various advanced cryptanalytic techniques, including linear and differential cryptanalysis." statement.zh: 设计理由最好从 AES 候选时代继承下来的轮函数争论里看。Twofish 论文把 FEAL 放进 Feistel 设计的谱系：「It is the basis of most block ciphers published since then, including FEAL [SM88], GOST [GOST89], Khufu and Khafre [Mer91], LOKI [BPS90, BKPS93], CAST-128 [Ada97a], Blowfish [Sch94], and RC5 [Riv95].」（它是此后发表的大多数分组密码的基础，其中包括 FEAL、GOST、Khufu 与 Khafre、LOKI、CAST-128、Blowfish 和 RC5）（twofish-paper.txt:232），并回忆这一谱系当年争的是形状而不只是强度：「The early post-DES cipher designs would often compete on the number of rounds in the cipher.」（早期后 DES 时代的密码设计常常以轮数相互竞争），「The original FEAL paper [SM88], for example, discussed the benefits of a stronger round function」（例如最初的 FEAL 论文讨论了更强的轮函数带来的好处）（第 1226 行——印出的段落在该处结束，下一行已另起一段，所以引文只到从句为止）。
statement.en: The design rationale is best seen in the round-function debate the AES-era submissions inherited.Twofish's paper places FEAL in the lineage of Feistel designs: "It is the basis of most block ciphers published since then, including FEAL [SM88], GOST [GOST89], Khufu and Khafre [Mer91], LOKI [BPS90, BKPS93], CAST-128 [Ada97a], Blowfish [Sch94], and RC5 [Riv95]." (twofish-paper.txt:232), and it recalls how that lineage argued about shape rather than only about strength: "The early post-DES cipher designs would often compete on the number of rounds in the cipher.

statement.zh: 留存文本把 FEAL 的用处放在两处，且都由来源自己说出而非推测。第一处是它为之内建的环境：Biham-Shamir 专著第 6 章开篇说 「FEAL was suggested as a software-oriented cryptosystem which can be easily and efficiently implemented on microprocessors.」（FEAL 是作为面向软件的密码系统提出的，可以在微处理器上容易而高效地实现），并解释这在部件上意味着什么，「In the F function, the P permutation and the S boxes of DES are replaced by byte rotations and addition operations.」（在 F 函数里，DES 的 P 置换与 S 盒被字节循环与加法运算取代）（biham-shamir-1993.txt:5935）；该书术语表在第 10635 行得出同一结论：「FEAL: A family of DES-like cryptosystems which is designed to be easily and efficiently implementable on microprocessors.
statement.en: The retained texts put FEAL's use in two places, both stated by the sources rather than assumed.The first is the environment it was built for: Chapter 6 of the Biham-Shamir book opens "FEAL was suggested as a software-oriented cryptosystem which can be easily and efficiently implemented on microprocessors." and explains what that meant for the parts, "In the F function, the P permutation and the S boxes of DES are replaced by byte rotations and addition operations." (biham-shamir-1993.txt:5935) - the same conclusion the book's own glossary reaches at 10635: "FEAL: A family of DES-like cryptosystems which is designed to be easily and efficiently implementable on microprocessors.

statement.zh: 留存文本把被攻破写成一段设计史，而不是单一事件。HAC 就前两个与商业相关的成员给出结论：「The initial commercially proposed version with 4 rounds (FEAL-4), positioned as a fast alternative to DES, was found to be considerably less secure than expected (see Table 7.10).」（最初作为商品提出的 4 轮版本 FEAL-4 被定位为 DES 的快速替代者，结果发现其安全性明显低于预期（见表 7.10）），以及 「FEAL-8 was similarly found to offer less security than planned.」（FEAL-8 同样被发现提供的安全少于计划）（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383）；两句的所指都是轮数，同一行还补上修补它的代价：「FEAL-16 or FEAL-32 may yet offer security comparable to DES, but throughput decreases as the number of rounds rises.」（FEAL-16 或 FEAL-32 或许仍能给出可与 DES 相比的安全，但吞吐量随轮数增加而下降）。这两句所指的表在第 1523 行引出：「Table 7.
statement.en: The breakage is recorded as design history rather than as a single event.HAC states the outcome for the first two commercially relevant members: "The initial commercially proposed version with 4 rounds (FEAL-4), positioned as a fast alternative to DES, was found to be considerably less secure than expected (see Table 7.10)." and "FEAL-8 was similarly found to offer less security than planned." (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383); the referent of both sentences is the round count, and the same line adds the price of fixing it: "FEAL-16 or FEAL-32 may yet offer security comparable to DES, but throughput decreases as the number of rounds rises.

statement.zh: 有年代的顺序就印在本章注释的一段里，该条目目保留它的次序与措辞。「FEAL stimulated the development of a sequence of advanced cryptanalytic techniques of unparalleled richness and utility.」（FEAL 刺激出一系列高级密码分析技术的发展，其丰富与有用前所未见）。第一条年代证据是 「FEAL-4 as presented at Eurocrypt'87 (Abstracts of Eurocrypt'87, April 1987) was found to have certain vulnerabilities by den Boer (unpublished Eurocrypt'87 rump session talk), resulting in Shimizu and Miyaguchi [1126] (or see Miyaguchi, Shiraishi, and Shimizu [887]) increasing FEAL to 8 rounds in the final proceedings.
statement.en: The dated sequence is printed in one paragraph of the chapter notes, and this entry keeps its order and its wording."FEAL stimulated the development of a sequence of advanced cryptanalytic techniques of unparalleled richness and utility."
